Added a built-in `web3d` skill that guides building single-file 3D web pages and browser games and checking them in a browser before handoff
The built-in `web3d` skill now plans each part's shape, surroundings and materials before building, and after the first working build a fresh tester subagent plays the page and writes a critique that must be closed before delivery, with a time guard on review rounds
The built-in `web3d` skill now stops checking a page as soon as you say stop or ask it to just open the page

title.zh-TW: 新增 `/game-3d-visuals`，`/blender` 也能做一般 3D 工作
title.en: New `/game-3d-visuals`, and `/blender` takes on general 3D work

body.zh-TW: 手上有幾張參考圖，想做出長得一樣的 3D 模型或遊戲畫面？新的 `/game-3d-visuals` 指令會依參考圖和一份視覺規格驅動 3D 模型與遊戲製作，並反覆比對渲染圖（電腦算出來的成品畫面）和參考圖，直到合格。`/blender` 則擴大到 Blender 裡的一般 3D 工作：建模、照一張圖重建場景、動畫和大型環境都能做，附帶的輔助腳本在 Blender 4 和 5 都能用。它也能拿渲染圖跟參考圖對量，逐格檢查動畫有沒有突然跳動、物體下沉或跑出鏡頭。折射的反彈次數也保留得更多，疊在一起的玻璃不會再渲染得那麼暗。
body.en: Have a few reference images and want a 3D model or game scene that matches them? The new `/game-3d-visuals` command drives 3D models and games from reference images and a visual spec, comparing each render (the finished image the computer calculates) against the references until it passes. `/blender` now covers general 3D work in Blender: object modeling, recreating a scene from an image, animation and large environments, with helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5. It can also measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot. It keeps more refraction bounces too, so stacked glass renders less dark.

items.original:
Added `/game-3d-visuals` to drive 3D models and games from reference images, a visual spec, and a render-vs-reference acceptance loop
`/blender` now handles general 3D work in Blender, including object modeling, scene recreation from an image, animation and large environments, and ships helper scripts that work on Blender 4 and 5
`/blender` can now measure a render against its reference image and check animations frame by frame for pops, sinking and objects leaving the shot, and keeps more refraction bounces so stacked glass renders less dark

title.zh-TW: 工作階段協定新增 `session/leave`，可把對話交給另一台主機
title.en: The session protocol adds `session/leave` to hand a session to another host

body.zh-TW: 自己寫用戶端、透過工作階段協定（讓其他程式操控 Muse 對話的溝通規則）接 Muse 的開發者，現在多了 `session/leave`。用戶端可以把一個已載入的工作階段交給另一台主機，原本這台主機和上面其他工作階段照常運作。⟦客服把一通電話轉給另一個部門，自己這條線和其他來電都不受影響，跟這個動作一模一樣。⟧另一個修正也跟搬動工作階段有關：主機把閒置的分支卸載後，或主機重新啟動後，用同一個指令重試 `session/fork`，以前會回內部錯誤，現在會拿回那個分支和它的歷史紀錄。
body.en: Developers who write their own clients on top of the session protocol (the rules other programs use to drive Muse conversations) now get `session/leave`. A client can hand one loaded session to another host while this host and its other sessions keep running. ⟦A support agent transfers one call to another department while their own line and every other caller carry on untouched.⟧ A related fix: retrying `session/fork` with the same command after the host unloaded the idle fork, or after a host restart, used to return an internal error; it now returns that fork and its history.

items.original:
Added `session/leave` to the session protocol, so a client can hand one loaded session to another host while this host and its other sessions keep running
Retrying `session/fork` with the same command after the host unloaded the idle fork, or after a host restart, now returns that fork and its history instead of an internal error

title.zh-TW: SDK 能回答 agent 的提問，續接時也收得到待核准的請求
title.en: The SDKs can answer the agent's questions and catch pending approvals on resume

body.zh-TW: 用 TypeScript 或 Python SDK 把 Muse 嵌進自己程式的人，可能遇過 agent 問了問題，程式卻沒辦法回答。現在 TypeScript 用 `Session.answerUserInput`、Python 用 `Session.answer_user_input` 就能回答，續接工作階段時還沒答的問題也行。續接時也能傳入核准處理器和核准失敗觀察器，續接當下還在等核准的請求會送到處理器，失敗則通知觀察器。SDK 以前會對不接受意見的核准選項送出意見，讓核准一直卡著；現在改回報新的 `feedbackNotAccepted` 失敗類型，列出哪些選項收意見，並改選提供的拒絕或中止選項讓這一輪繼續。程式若逐一處理每種 `ApprovalFailure`，要補上這個新類型。
body.en: If you embed Muse in your own program with the TypeScript or Python SDK, you may have had the agent ask a question your code could not answer. Now TypeScript can answer with `Session.answerUserInput` and Python with `Session.answer_user_input`, including a question still open when a session is resumed. When resuming, you can also pass an approval handler and an approval-failure observer, so an approval still pending at resume reaches the handler and any failure reaches the observer. The SDKs used to send feedback on an approval choice that does not accept it, which left the approval open; they now report the new `feedbackNotAccepted` failure kind, listing the choices that accept feedback, and answer with the offered deny or abort choice so the turn goes on. Code that handles every `ApprovalFailure` kind needs a case for it.

items.original:
The TypeScript and Python SDKs can answer the agent's questions with `Session.answerUserInput` and `Session.answer_user_input`, including a question still open when a session is resumed
The TypeScript and Python SDKs accept an approval handler and an approval-failure observer when resuming a session, so an approval still pending at resume reaches the handler and any failure reaches the observer
The TypeScript and Python SDKs no longer send feedback on an approval choice that does not accept it, which left the approval open; they report the new `feedbackNotAccepted` failure kind (listing the choices that accept feedback) and answer with the offered deny or abort choice so the turn goes on, and code that handles every `ApprovalFailure` kind needs a case for it

title.zh-TW: SDK 補收漏掉的事件時，不再提早收工
title.en: The SDKs no longer stop filling event gaps too early

body.zh-TW: SDK 和 Muse 之間的事件偶爾會漏送，這時 SDK 要把缺口補齊。以前較早的缺口通知如果在較晚那則之後又送到一次，Python 和 TypeScript SDK 會提早停止補缺口，甚至回報工作階段已是最新，其實還少了事件。⟦郵差把上週的補寄通知晚於本週的送來，以前你就以為信都到齊、不再等了，現在你認得出那是舊通知，直接丟掉。⟧現在重複的舊通知，Python 會回 `IgnoredStaleFrame`，TypeScript 會回 `ignoredStaleFrame`。TypeScript 的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 也多了 `view/gap`，程式若逐一比對它的每個值，要補一個新分支。
body.en: Events between the SDK and Muse sometimes go missing, and the SDK then has to fill the gap. When an earlier gap notice was redelivered after a later one, the Python and TypeScript SDKs used to stop filling the gap early, or even report the session current while events were still missing. ⟦When last week's redelivery notice arrived after this week's, you used to assume all the mail was in and stop waiting; now you recognize it as an old notice and toss it.⟧ The repeated notice now returns `IgnoredStaleFrame` in Python and `ignoredStaleFrame` in TypeScript. TypeScript's `StaleDroppableMethod` also gains `view/gap`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case.

items.original:
The Python SDK no longer stops filling a delivery gap early, or reports the session current with events missing, when an earlier gap notice is redelivered after a later one; the repeat now returns `IgnoredStaleFrame`
The TypeScript SDK no longer stops filling a delivery gap early, or reports the session current with events missing, when an earlier gap notice is redelivered after a later one; the repeat now returns `ignoredStaleFrame`, and `StaleDroppableMethod` gains `view/gap`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case

title.zh-TW: agent 外掛能附 MCP 伺服器，用 `muse mcp login` 登入
title.en: Agent plugins can bring MCP servers with `muse mcp login` sign-in

body.zh-TW: 想裝一個外掛，順便把它要用的外部服務也接好？agent 外掛現在可以附帶 MCP 伺服器（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定），每個伺服器各自審核，並用 `muse mcp login` 登入。Windows 上，外掛的 hook（特定時機自動觸發的小程式）若用 `/bin/bash` 這類根目錄路徑啟動程式，以前安裝會失敗並顯示「plugin capability path must stay inside plugin root」，現在裝得起來。審核過的 skill 在登入後重新啟用時，授權也不會掉：審核過的 `allowed-tools` 保留預先核准，不會在未登入啟動之後退回跳出核准視窗。
body.en: Want a plugin to set up the outside services it needs at install time? Agent plugins can now supply MCP servers (the protocol that connects AI to external tools), each with its own review and `muse mcp login` sign-in. On Windows, plugins whose hooks (small programs triggered automatically at certain moments) start a program by a rooted path such as `/bin/bash` used to fail to install with "plugin capability path must stay inside plugin root"; they now install. A reviewed skill also keeps its grant when it is re-armed after login: reviewed `allowed-tools` keep their preapproval instead of falling back to an approval prompt after a logged-out start.

items.original:
Agent plugins can supply MCP servers with per-server review and `muse mcp login` sign-in
On Windows, plugins whose hooks start a program by a rooted path such as `/bin/bash` now install instead of failing with "plugin capability path must stay inside plugin root"
A reviewed skill's invocation-grant resolver now survives the post-login re-arm, so reviewed `allowed-tools` keep their preapproval instead of falling back to an approval prompt after a logged-out start

title.zh-TW: `muse exec --json` 列出每次執行的 token 用量，`/usage` 也算進背景工作
title.en: `muse exec --json` reports token usage per run, and `/usage` counts background work

body.zh-TW: 用腳本跑 Muse、想知道每次花了多少，現在不用自己估。`muse exec --json` 會在每次執行結束前印一行 `run.usage`，列出這次各模型用了多少 token（AI 計算用量的單位），以及你訂閱方案的額度。`/usage` 的總數也把背景工作算進去了，並在另一列 Observers 單獨列出。⟦水費帳單以前只算客廳的水龍頭，現在連後院自動灑水也計入，還分開列一行讓你看清楚。⟧
body.en: If you run Muse from scripts and want to know what each run cost, you no longer have to guess. `muse exec --json` prints a `run.usage` line before each run ends, with the run's token usage (the unit AI usage is measured in) per model and your subscription allowance. `/usage` totals now include background work too, broken out in a separate Observers row. ⟦A water bill that used to count only the kitchen tap now includes the backyard sprinklers, listed on their own line so you can see them.⟧

items.original:
`muse exec --json` prints a `run.usage` line before each run ends, with the run's token usage per model and your subscription allowance
`/usage` totals now include background work and break it out in a separate Observers row

title.zh-TW: `muse serve` 可用環境設定調容量，當機後重開的對話不再卡住
title.en: `muse serve` takes capacity settings, and chats reopened after a crash no longer look stuck

body.zh-TW: 把 Muse 架成服務給多個程式共用的話，`muse serve` 現在讀三個環境設定，分別控制工作執行緒、指令受理容量和最多載入幾個工作階段；值寫錯會報出來，並改用正式環境的值。服務執行中你才登入、帳號卻還沒完成初始設定時，回合以前只叫你再登入一次，現在會說明該怎麼做。當機把工作階段紀錄的結尾截掉後，重開的對話以前看起來像卡住，現在歷史、新回合和核准請求都會正常顯示。讀長訊息、工作流程子任務的提示或原始網頁搜尋結果的下一頁時，如果沒有新存檔，也不再把整段對話重讀一遍。
body.en: If you run Muse as a service shared by several programs, `muse serve` now reads three environment settings for its worker threads, command admission capacity and loaded-session ceiling; an invalid value is reported and the production value is used. When you log in while it is running and your account still needs onboarding, turns used to just ask you to log in again; they now say what to do. A chat reopened after a crash cut the end of its session log used to look stuck; its history, new turns and approval requests now show again. Reading the next page of a long agent message, a workflow child's prompt or a raw web-search result no longer rereads the whole chat while nothing new has been saved.

items.original:
`muse serve` reads three environment settings for its worker threads, command admission capacity, and loaded-session ceiling; an invalid value is reported and the production value is used
When you log in while `muse serve` is running and your account still needs onboarding, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again
A `muse serve` chat reopened after a crash cut the end of its session log now shows its history, new turns and approval requests again, instead of looking stuck
In `muse serve`, reading the next page of a long agent message, a workflow child's prompt or a raw web-search result no longer rereads the whole chat while nothing new has been saved

title.zh-TW: 支援 OSC 7501 的終端機，看得到 Muse 每一項背景工作
title.en: Terminals with OSC 7501 show every piece of background work Muse is running

body.zh-TW: Muse 同時在背景跑好幾件事時，你很難知道它到底在忙什麼，又是哪一件在等你。支援程式狀態回報（OSC 7501）的終端機，現在會顯示工作階段正在跑的每個監控和背景終端機。工作流程、子代理和背景的後續回合也會一一列出，還會標出哪一個正在等你回應。⟦機場看板以前只掛一班飛機，現在每班的狀態都上板，哪一班在等你登機一眼就看到。⟧
body.en: When Muse runs several things in the background, it is hard to tell what it is busy with and which one is waiting on you. Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now show each monitor and background terminal a session is running. Each workflow, subagent and background follow-up turn is listed too, along with which one is waiting for you. ⟦An airport board that used to show just one flight now lists every flight's status, so you spot the one waiting for you to board at a glance.⟧

items.original:
Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now also show each monitor and background terminal a session is running
Terminals that support program status reports (OSC 7501) now also show each workflow, subagent and background follow-up turn a session is running, and which one is waiting for you

title.zh-TW: 網路核准預設選「這次不再問」，自動審查不再把本機請求全丟給你
title.en: Network approvals default to "don't ask again", and auto-review stops handing you every local request

body.zh-TW: Muse 要連某個網址時會先問你，以前同一個目的地可能一問再問。現在網路核准提示預設停在「Yes, don't ask again this session」，只針對那個主機和連接埠，直接按 Enter，同一個目的地就不會再問。自動審查（Auto-review）以前看到連往 `localhost` 或 `127.0.0.1` 的請求，光憑位址或連接埠就整個交給你決定，現在會像其他動作一樣自己審。續接一個明確關掉審查員的 Auto-review 工作階段時，以前會被拒絕，現在照當時記下的人工設定繼續。
body.en: Muse asks before connecting to an address, and the same destination could ask again and again. Network approval prompts now start on "Yes, don't ask again this session" for that exact host and port, so pressing Enter stops the same destination from asking again. Auto-review used to hand you every request to a local server on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` just because of its address or port; it now reviews them like any other action. Resuming an Auto-review session with the reviewer explicitly turned off used to be refused; it now proceeds under the recorded human override.

items.original:
Network approval prompts now start on "Yes, don't ask again this session" for that exact host and port, so pressing Enter stops the same destination from asking again
Auto-review no longer hands you every request to a local server on `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` just because of its address or port; it reviews them like any other action
Resuming an Auto-review session with the reviewer explicitly off now proceeds under the recorded human override instead of refusing, matching gate-off

title.zh-TW: 工作流程當機後續跑，不再重跑已完成的子代理
title.en: Resuming a Workflow after a crash no longer reruns finished subagents

body.zh-TW: 長時間的工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動執行的機制）跑到一半當機，最怕續跑時從頭再來。現在續跑時，在不同時間點已完成的平行子代理不會再重跑，也不會警告存下的復原狀態不可信，除非當機時還有更早啟動的子代理在跑。續跑被拒或啟動後失敗，現在會記下最終結果，用戶端不會一直顯示工作流程還開著。工作流程啟動後的部分歷史遺失、讀不到工作階段的歷史檔，或缺的部分包含工作流程怎麼啟動的紀錄時，續跑都會停下來說明原因，請你重跑那段工作，不再硬接著跑、從頭重跑或只丟一個沒頭沒尾的錯誤。
body.en: When a long Workflow (a mechanism that chains subtasks to run automatically) crashes halfway, the worst outcome is starting over on resume. Resuming now no longer reruns parallel subagents that had already finished at different times, or warns that the saved recovery state was not trustworthy, unless a subagent started before them was still running at the crash. A Workflow resume that is refused or fails after launch now records its final outcome, so clients no longer show the Workflow as open. When part of the saved history written after the Workflow started is missing, when Muse cannot read the session's history file, or when the missing part includes how the Workflow started, resuming now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of pressing on, rerunning from the start or failing with a bare error.

items.original:
Resuming a Workflow after a crash no longer reruns parallel subagents that had already finished at different times, or warns that the saved recovery state was not trustworthy, unless a subagent started before them was still running at the crash
A Workflow resume that is refused or fails after launch now records its terminal reconciliation, so clients no longer show the Workflow as open until the host exits
When part of a session's saved history written after a Workflow started is missing, resuming that Workflow now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of continuing it
When Muse can't read a session's saved history file, resuming a Workflow from that session now stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of re-running the Workflow from the start
When the missing part of a session's saved history includes the record of how a Workflow started, resuming that Workflow now also stops with the reason and asks you to run that work again, instead of failing with a bare error

title.zh-TW: 工作流程的子代理指定模型時不再被誤拒
title.en: Workflow subagents that name a model are no longer wrongly refused

body.zh-TW: 明明指名的就是正在用的模型，子代理卻不肯開工，讓人摸不著頭緒。現在工作流程裡的子代理指名的若正是工作階段在用的模型，就算它在模型清單裡被隱藏或不見，也照常執行，跟不指定模型一樣。在舊版開始的工作階段裡，只要 `/model` 對你的供應商列出該模型一次，指名它的子代理也能執行。工作流程裡的代理讀取存下的結果時，會拿到來源和欄位標籤；摘要清單省略較早的結果時，就算完整結果還在，也會收到通知。ParallelGroup 拒絕執行時，錯誤訊息會點名 members 參數和 .defer 改法，不再只給籠統的資料錯誤或內部代理編號。
body.en: Naming a model for a subagent in a Workflow could get refused for no clear reason. A Workflow subagent that names the model your session is running now runs even when that model is hidden or missing from the model list, the same as leaving the model out. In sessions first started on an older version, a subagent that names a model now runs when `/model` lists that model once for your provider. Workflow agents receive source and field labels when reading saved results, and get a notice when the summary list omits earlier results, even when full results are available. ParallelGroup refusals now name the members argument and the .defer correction instead of a generic plain-data error or an internal agent identifier.

Workflow agents receive source and field labels when reading saved results
ParallelGroup refusals now name the members argument and the .defer correction instead of a generic plain-data error or an internal agent identifier
A Workflow subagent that names the model your session is running now runs even when that model is hidden or missing from the model list, the same as leaving the model out
Workflow agents now get a notice when the summary list omits earlier results, even when full results are available
A Workflow subagent that names a model now runs in sessions first started on an older version, when `/model` lists that model once for your provider, instead of being refused

title.zh-TW: Muse 只說下一步卻沒動手時，會被催著繼續做
title.en: When Muse only announces its next step, it is nudged to keep going

body.zh-TW: 請 Muse 做事，它回一句「接下來我會……」就停了，你只好再打一次「繼續」。現在模型只交代下一步、沒有呼叫任何工具時，agent 會請它接著做，每次執行最多催兩次。子代理因設定的模型不能用而改用工作階段模型時，啟動它的 agent 仍會知道實際跑的是哪個模型。Muse 當機重啟後，agent 直接啟動、還沒開始跑的子代理不會自己再啟動一次，而是給上層一個「結果不明」，讓它檢查後決定要不要重開。你回答問題或傳新訊息前備好的 skill 提醒，現在會被丟掉，Muse 不會照著已經過時的建議行動；背景任務完成時，也不再重問還沒答的問題。
body.en: You ask Muse to do something, it replies "next I will…" and stops, and you have to type "continue" again. Now, when the model only says what it will do next and calls no tool, the agent asks it to go on, up to twice per run. When a subagent runs on the session model because its configured model is unavailable, the agent that started it is still told which model ran. After Muse restarts from a crash, a subagent the agent started directly that had not started running yet is no longer started again by itself; its parent gets one result saying the outcome is unknown, so it can check and start it again if still needed. A skill reminder prepared before you answered Muse's question or sent another message is now dropped, so Muse no longer acts on guidance your answer already settled, and the agent no longer repeats a pending question when a background task finishes.

items.original:
After Muse restarts from a crash, a subagent the agent started directly (not from a workflow) that had not started running yet is no longer started again by itself; its parent gets one result saying the outcome is unknown, so it can check and start the subagent again if still needed
When a subagent runs on the session model because its configured model is unavailable, the agent that started it is still told which model ran
When the model only says what it will do next and calls no tool, the agent asks it to go on (up to twice per run) instead of ending the turn there
A skill reminder prepared before you answered Muse's question or sent it another message is now dropped instead of reaching Muse as current advice, so Muse no longer acts on guidance your answer already settled
Agent no longer repeats a pending question when a background task finishes

title.zh-TW: 壓縮時檢查點沒存成，下一回合會補存，長對話重開又快了
title.en: Missed checkpoints during compaction are saved next turn, so long sessions reopen fast again

body.zh-TW: 很長的工作階段要重新打開，靠的是檢查點（記錄對話進度的存檔）才能快速接上。壓縮對話時如果檢查點沒存成，下一回合現在會補存，而且不再多做一次摘要，重開長對話又快了。側邊對話在壓縮時正在跑工具，或取消的工作流程工具存不下來時，那次壓縮現在也會存好續接用的檢查點。磁碟滿或寫入失敗排除後，下一個檢查點會正常儲存，不再又跳過一次。壓縮檢查點失敗又無法回復時，工作階段以前每一步都重新摘要同一段歷史，現在會保留每份摘要繼續往下。長工作階段也會在檢查點修剪已涵蓋的紀錄，不再無限長大。
body.en: Reopening a long session quickly depends on checkpoints (saves that record the conversation's progress). When a checkpoint could not be saved during a compaction, the next turn now saves it without another summary, so reopening a long session is fast again. Compactions that happen while a side chat is mid-tool, or after a cancelled workflow tool could not be saved, now save their resume checkpoint too. After a full disk or a failed write clears, the next checkpoint is saved instead of being skipped once more. A session whose compaction checkpoint failed and could not be rolled back used to re-summarize the same history on every step; it now keeps each summary and continues. Long sessions also trim covered records at checkpoints instead of growing without bound.

items.original:
When a context checkpoint could not be saved during a compaction, the next turn now saves it without another summary, so reopening a long session is fast again
Resuming a session stays fast after a side chat was mid-tool during a compaction, or after a cancelled workflow tool could not be saved; those compactions now save their resume checkpoint
Long sessions trim covered records at checkpoints instead of growing without bound
After a full disk or a failed write clears, the next context checkpoint is saved instead of being skipped once more
A session whose compaction checkpoint failed and could not be rolled back no longer re-summarizes the same history on every step; it keeps each compacted summary and continues

title.zh-TW: 有背景任務或分支對話時，檢查點也照常儲存
title.en: Checkpoints keep saving alongside background tasks and branched chats

body.zh-TW: Muse 多線並行時，記錄對話進度的檢查點（重開對話時用來快速接上的存檔）以前常被默默漏存。工具執行中有監控或背景任務回報時，這一回合剩下的檢查點現在不再被跳過。在來源對話同一次開啟裡打開的分支、倒回或側邊對話，現在會存自己的檢查點，不必等到 app 重開。重開對話後才完成的背景任務，就算啟動它的回合無法還原，也不再擋住壓縮存檢查點。背景任務還在跑時重開已存的對話，任務完成後，檢查點和任務結果都會照常記錄下來。
body.en: With background tasks, forks or side chats open, checkpoints (saves that record the conversation's progress) used to get skipped quietly. Checkpoints are no longer skipped for the rest of a turn when a monitor or background task reports in while tools are running. A forked, rewound or side chat opened in the same app run as its source now saves its checkpoints instead of skipping them until the app restarts. A background task that finishes after you reopen a chat no longer stops compaction from saving checkpoints when the turn that started it could not be restored. Reopening a saved chat while a task it started is still running no longer stops the checkpoint, or the task's result, from being recorded when that task finishes.

items.original:
Context checkpoints are no longer skipped for the rest of a turn when a monitor or background task reports in while tools are running
A forked, rewound or side chat opened in the same app run as its source now saves its context checkpoints, instead of skipping them until the app restarts
A background task that finishes after you reopen a chat no longer stops compaction from saving checkpoints when the turn that started it could not be restored
Reopening a saved chat while a background task it started is still running no longer stops compaction from saving its checkpoint, or the task's result from being recorded, when that task finishes

title.zh-TW: `/compact` 在續接和分支的對話裡都能正常用
title.en: `/compact` works properly in resumed and forked chats

body.zh-TW: 手動打 `/compact` 壓縮對話，卻看不出到底成功沒有？續接工作階段後，`/compact` 現在會在對話紀錄裡顯示「◆ Context compacted」結果列，不再默默毫無變化。續接的分支對話裡，`/compact` 可以重複使用。正在看背景結果時打 `/compact`，現在壓縮的是最新的主要執行，不是那份背景結果。重開的對話裡，如果子代理的結果剛好在先前某次壓縮前才存進去，以前之後每次壓縮都會失敗，現在不會。agent 工作時你先打好的排隊輸入，會在回合結束後的壓縮做完就執行，不再停在閒置的提示前空等。
body.en: Type `/compact` and cannot tell whether it worked? After resuming a session, `/compact` now shows its `◆ Context compacted` outcome row in the transcript instead of silently leaving it unchanged. In resumed forked conversations, `/compact` works repeatedly. Issued while viewing a background delivery, `/compact` now compacts the newest top-level run instead of the delivery run. A reopened chat no longer fails every compaction when a subagent delivery was saved late, just before an earlier compaction. Input you queued while the agent was working now runs after a post-turn compaction instead of waiting at an idle prompt.

items.original:
Queued input typed while the agent was working now runs after a post-turn context compaction instead of waiting at an idle prompt
After resuming a session, `/compact` now shows its `◆ Context compacted` outcome row in the transcript instead of silently leaving the transcript unchanged
A reopened chat no longer fails every compaction when a subagent delivery was saved late, just before an earlier compaction
`/compact` works repeatedly in resumed forked conversations
/compact issued while viewing a background delivery now compacts the newest top-level run instead of the delivery run

title.zh-TW: 磁碟滿造成的寫入失敗，不再讓對話打不開
title.en: Write failures from a full disk no longer lock you out of a chat

body.zh-TW: 磁碟滿了是常見的意外，但不該讓整段對話報銷。工具結果因磁碟滿等原因寫不進去的對話，現在不必重開 app 就能再打開。工具呼叫寫不進去、結果卻寫進去的對話，重開後也打得開，只把那一回合擱置，Muse 會說明一次。記錄工作流程啟動結果時遇到磁碟錯誤，對話以前會一直停止存檔到重開為止，現在不會。用圖片倒回所建立的對話，在自動保留歷史的檢查點之後，倒回更早的回合也不再失敗。
body.en: A full disk is a common mishap, but it should not wreck a whole conversation. A saved chat whose tool result could not be written to disk, for example on a full disk, now opens again without a restart. A chat whose tool call could not be written while its result was written now opens after a restart; only that turn is set aside, and Muse says so once. A disk error while recording a workflow launch result no longer stops the chat from saving until restart. In a conversation created by rewinding with an image, rewinding to an earlier turn no longer fails after an automatic history-preserving checkpoint.

items.original:
A chat no longer stops saving until restart after a disk error while recording a workflow launch result
A saved chat whose tool result could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) now opens again without a restart
Rewinding to an earlier turn no longer fails after an automatic history-preserving checkpoint in a conversation created by rewinding with an image
A chat whose tool call could not be written to disk (for example on a full disk) while its result was written now opens again after a restart; only that turn is set aside, and Muse says so once

title.zh-TW: 續接工作階段時，歷史、推理和背景狀態都會保留
title.en: Resumed sessions keep their history, reasoning and background status

body.zh-TW: 隔天回來想接著昨天的工作做，最怕打開是空的或少了一截。自動更新時還開著的工作階段，現在續接會帶回歷史，不再空空如也。有待處理背景結果的對話，續接時不再冒出不必要的上下文上限錯誤。檢查點修剪後續接，那些在新一代沒提供工具的 MCP 伺服器（連接外部工具的服務），工具身分綁定不會再弄丟。透過 `muse serve` 續接最早在 `muse` 供應商標籤下記錄、又用了記錄事件外掛的對話，先前的推理會保留，不再被當成別家的丟掉。重開側邊對話或分支後，背景工作狀態仍看得到；續接時也會自動取好名字。
body.en: Coming back the next day to pick up where you left off, the worst surprise is an empty or truncated session. A session left running through an auto-update now resumes with its history instead of coming back empty. Conversations with pending background results resume without unnecessary context limit errors. Resuming after a checkpoint prune no longer loses MCP (servers that connect external tools) tool identity bindings for servers that contribute no tools in the new generation. Resuming over `muse serve` a chat first recorded under the `muse` provider label that also used a plugin recording session events now keeps its earlier reasoning instead of dropping it as another provider's. Background work status stays available after reopening a side conversation or fork, and a resumed session gets its automatic name.

items.original:
Resuming a session after a checkpoint prune no longer loses MCP tool identity bindings for servers that contribute no tools in the new generation
Resume conversations with pending background results without unnecessary context limit errors
Resuming over `muse serve` a chat first recorded under the `muse` provider label that also used a plugin recording session events now keeps its earlier reasoning instead of dropping it as another provider's
A session left running through an auto-update now resumes with its history instead of coming back empty
Gate-on resume settles the session's automatic name like gate-off instead of leaving the reopen unnamed
Keep background work status available after reopening a side conversation or fork

title.zh-TW: 續接清單載入變快，分支裡的 `/fork` 不再失敗
title.en: The resume picker loads faster, and `/fork` works inside forks

body.zh-TW: 工作階段一多，打開續接選單往下捲就越來越慢。現在每多載一頁，不再把已載入的每一列重掃一遍，清單再長也維持同樣速度；打開分支工作階段時的重複歷史掃描也減少了。選單會註明沒有任何回合的工作階段不會保留。續接撞到衝突時，訊息會點名是哪個工作階段伺服器佔著，不再建議你把它砍掉。從已壓縮對話分出來的分支裡再用 `/fork`，以前會失敗並顯示「source Goal state changed or failed validation」，現在可以正常用。
body.en: The more sessions you have, the slower the resume picker got as you scrolled. Paging in more sessions no longer rescans every loaded row for each new one, so long lists keep loading at the same speed, and opening forked sessions repeats fewer history scans. The picker notes that sessions with no turns are not kept. A resume conflict now names the session server holding it instead of suggesting you kill it. `/fork` in a forked chat branched from a compacted chat used to fail with "source Goal state changed or failed validation"; it now works.

items.original:
`/fork` now works in a forked chat that was branched from a compacted chat, instead of failing with "source Goal state changed or failed validation"
Paging more sessions into the resume picker now stays linear instead of rescanning every loaded row for each new one, so long session lists keep loading pages at the same speed
Resume conflict names the holding session server instead of suggesting killing it
Resume picker notes that sessions with no turns are not kept
Reduce repeated history scans when opening forked sessions

title.zh-TW: 按量計費時，存好的貢獻者模型不再被換成標準價模型
title.en: Pay-as-you-go sessions keep your saved contributor model

body.zh-TW: 你特地存好要用的貢獻者模型，工作階段一開頭跑的卻不是它。這發生在按量計費（用多少付多少）的工作階段：以前在訂閱檢查回覆之前，會先換成標準價的基礎模型。現在從第一個請求起就保留你存的模型；啟動時被重新對應過的，訂閱檢查一回覆也會換回來。⟦在餐廳指定了主廚，以前櫃台還沒查完會員資格，就先派一般廚師上菜，現在第一道菜就是你點的那位主廚做的。⟧
body.en: In pay-as-you-go sessions (you pay for what you use) with a saved contributor model, the model used to be mapped to the standard-price base until the subscription check answered. Now the saved model is kept from the first request, and one remapped at startup is restored as soon as the subscription check answers. ⟦You requested a particular chef, but the front desk used to send out the regular cook until it finished checking your membership; now your chef makes the very first dish.⟧

items.original:
Pay-as-you-go sessions restore a saved contributor model remapped at startup once the subscription check answers, instead of staying on the standard-price base
Pay-as-you-go sessions keep a saved contributor model from the first request, instead of mapping it to the standard-price base until the subscription check answers

title.zh-TW: 服務重啟前會先核對身分，不再誤停長得像的工作階段
title.en: Restarts check ownership first and leave look-alike sessions running

body.zh-TW: 同時開好幾個 Muse 工作階段時，重啟一個服務不該順手把別的也關掉。服務和迴圈重啟前，現在會拿擁有權紀錄逐一核對每個程序，長得像、但不屬於它的工作階段會留著繼續跑。側邊對話的嘗試現在記在來源工作階段上，不再直接丟掉；搶不到資源的側邊對話照樣開得起來，重試時會補上或接上先前的結果。工作階段保留機制以前只要背景讀一次紀錄失敗，就永遠放棄那個工作階段，現在會在之後再讀，過了保留期限一樣會正常到期。
body.en: With several Muse sessions open, restarting one service should not take the others down with it. Service and loop restarts now verify every process against an ownership record before stopping it, so look-alike sessions are left running. Side chats now record their attempts on the source session instead of dropping them; a contended side chat still opens, and a retry backfills or joins the earlier outcome. Session retention used to give up on a session forever when one background read of its log failed; the read is now retried later, so the session still expires once it is past the retention period.

items.original:
Side chats now record their attempts on the source session instead of dropping them, matching gate-off; a contended side still opens and a retry backfills or joins the prior outcome
Service and loop restarts verify every process against an ownership record before stopping it, so look-alike sessions are left running
Session retention no longer gives up on a session forever when one background read of its log fails; the read is retried on a later pass, so the session still expires once it is past the retention period

title.zh-TW: 表格每列都有分隔線，`/new` 和 `/clear` 立刻清畫面
title.en: Tables get row lines, and `/new` and `/clear` clear the screen at once

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡看 Muse 回覆，有幾個小地方變順眼了。回覆裡的表格現在每一列之間都畫分隔線。打 `/new` 或 `/clear` 會立刻清空畫面，不再讓舊對話停留好幾秒；新工作階段啟動時你同時打字，第一個字母也不會被吃掉。TUI（在終端機裡畫出來的操作介面）收到工作階段列時，不再清掉終端機原本的捲動紀錄，對話紀錄裡的工作階段列也不會畫兩次。
body.en: Reading Muse's replies in the terminal got a little easier on the eyes. Tables in replies now draw a line between every row. `/new` and `/clear` clear the screen immediately instead of leaving the old chat visible for seconds, and text you type while the fresh session starts no longer loses its first letter. The TUI (the interface drawn inside the terminal) no longer erases the terminal's existing scrollback when session rows arrive, and session rows no longer render twice in the transcript.

items.original:
Tables in assistant replies draw a line between every row
The TUI no longer erases the terminal's pre-existing scrollback when session rows arrive, matching gate-off
Text you type while `/new` or `/clear` starts a fresh session no longer loses its first letter
Session rows no longer render twice in the TUI transcript
/new and /clear now clear the screen immediately instead of leaving the old chat visible for seconds

title.zh-TW: 讀影片改在本機擷取畫格，錯誤訊息不再出現兩次
title.en: Video reads extract frames locally, and errors show only once

body.zh-TW: 交給 Muse 一支影片、要它看內容時，它現在會引導在本機擷取畫格，不必把影片上傳。回合失敗前已經收到部分輸出時，錯誤現在只顯示一次，不再出現兩次。排隊輸入面板在訊息更新失敗時會說明，也會告訴你輸入仍然有效。`/stop all` 期間剛好完成的任務，會回報為已完成，不再讓停止動作失敗。同一段對話裡，也不再一再載入表格格式的 skill。
body.en: Hand Muse a video to look at, and it now guides local frame extraction without uploading the video. When partial output arrived before a turn failed, the error now shows once instead of twice. The queued input panel says when message updates fail and that your input still works. Tasks that finish during `/stop all` are reported as already finished instead of failing the stop. The table-formatting skill is no longer loaded again and again within a conversation.

items.original:
Video file reads guide local frame extraction without uploading the video
The queued input panel says when message updates fail and that your input still works
Avoid repeated table-formatting skill loads within a conversation
Report tasks that finish during `/stop all` as already finished instead of failing the stop
A failed turn now shows its error once instead of twice when partial output arrived before the failure finished

title.zh-TW: 工具執行的指令併入同一條追蹤，hook 的 `model_provider` 恢復正確
title.en: Tool-run commands join the turn's trace, and the hook `model_provider` is correct again

body.zh-TW: 想追查 Muse 一回合裡到底跑了哪些指令，以前會看到一堆找不到上層的零散追蹤紀錄。現在工具執行的指令，包括 shell、MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）呼叫、hook、背景終端機和 `!` shell，都會併進該回合的追蹤，像 `meta` 這類工具產生的下游紀錄，會掛在執行它的工具呼叫底下。⟦家譜上原本有一群人找不到父母，現在每個人都接回自己那一支。⟧在每條 Meta 閘道連線上，包括公司 Mac 啟動器，Muse 模型的 hook（特定時機自動觸發的小程式）輸入 `model_provider` 又會是 `meta`；透過 Meta 閘道提供的 Claude 和 GPT 模型，則照舊不帶這個欄位。
body.en: Trying to trace which commands ran in a Muse turn used to turn up a pile of orphaned traces with no parent. Commands run by tools, including shell, MCP (the protocol that connects AI to external tools) calls, hooks, background terminals and `!` shell, now join the turn's trace, so downstream spans from tools like `meta` nest under the tool call that ran them. ⟦A family tree that had a group of people with no parents now has everyone reattached to their own branch.⟧ On every Meta gateway connection, including the corp Mac launcher, the hook (a small program triggered automatically at certain moments) input `model_provider` is `meta` again for Muse models, and it is still omitted for Claude and GPT models served through the Meta gateway.

items.original:
Hook input `model_provider` is `meta` again for Muse models on every Meta gateway connection, including the corp Mac launcher, and is still omitted for Claude and GPT models served through the Meta gateway
Commands run by tools (shell, MCP calls, hooks, background terminals, `!` shell) now join the turn's trace instead of starting orphan traces, so downstream spans from tools like `meta` nest under the tool call that ran them

Reduce memory use when loading sessions with repeated approval records

title.zh-TW: /blender 指令登場，參考圖直接重建為 3D 可編輯場景
title.en: /blender Command Debuts to Reconstruct Reference Images Directly into Editable 3D Scenes

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊有一張概念設計圖或參考照片，想快速建立立體模型時，往往需要在建模程式裡從零搭建物件與燈光。新推出的 `/blender` 指令能依據參考圖片，自動重建出可自由編輯的 Blender（一套開源三維繪圖工具）場景。⟦就像拿著一張平面設計草圖走進工作室，模型師當場組裝出能拆卸零件、隨意更換視角的立體模型。⟧這讓你省去繁瑣的手動對位，產出的檔案也能立刻在編輯器內接續調整視角、材質與燈光。
body.en:
When you have a concept design sketch or reference photo and want to quickly create a 3D model, you often need to build objects and lighting from scratch in modeling software. The newly introduced `/blender` command automatically reconstructs a freely editable Blender (an open-source 3D modeling tool) scene based on reference images.

⟦Picture walking into a studio with a 2D design sketch, where a modeler immediately assembles a 3D model with detachable parts and freely adjustable viewing angles on the spot.⟧

This saves you from tedious manual alignment, and the generated files can immediately be used to adjust perspectives, materials, and lighting directly in the editor.

items.original: Added `/blender` to reconstruct reference images as editable Blender scenes

title.zh-TW: 電腦操作精簡工具呼叫，跳過重複查閱與多餘清單直奔目標
title.en: Computer Use Streamlines Tool Calls, Skipping Redundant Checks and Lists to Head Straight for Goals

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代理操作桌面螢幕時，每多呼叫一次工具，都會拉長等待時間並消耗額度。電腦操作（Computer Use，讓 AI 透過視覺畫面模擬人類點擊與輸入的機制）現在減少了許多冗餘的工具呼叫。當任務明確指定某個應用程式時，它會直接啟動該程式，不再先列出所有應用程式清單；遇到檔案或系統查詢，會直接以終端機指令回答；它還會跳過重複閱讀自身說明的動作。⟦好比熟練的助理接獲指令便立刻動手，不再反覆翻閱員工手冊或把工具箱裡的物件逐一清點一遍。⟧就算畫面當下看起來像是已經做完，它仍會依照指示確實執行任務。
body.en:
When having an AI agent operate desktop screens, every extra tool call prolongs waiting times and consumes quota. Computer Use (a mechanism that lets AI simulate human clicks and keystrokes through visual screens) now cuts out many redundant tool calls. When a task explicitly specifies an application, it launches that program directly instead of first listing all applications. When encountering file or system queries, it answers directly with terminal commands. It also skips repeatedly re-reading its own instructions.

⟦Think of a skilled assistant getting straight to work upon receiving an order, instead of repeatedly leafing through the employee handbook or counting every item in the toolbox.⟧

Even if the screen currently looks like the task is already finished, it still carries out the assignment faithfully according to instructions.

items.original: Computer Use makes fewer tool calls: it skips re-reading its own instructions, opens the app a task clearly points to without listing apps first, answers file and system questions with the shell, and does the task even when the screen already looks done

title.zh-TW: 背景任務提示頻率降至單次，監聽狀態即刻顯示且長程目標不中斷
title.en: Background Task Prompts Reduced to Once, Displaying Listening States Instantly Without Halting Goal Runs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動耗時較長的工作時，對話視窗的提示頻率與狀態顯示有了更清晰的安排。執行超過 30 分鐘的背景指令，現在只會主動提示代理一次，不再每隔半小時就提醒，需要時由代理自行排定後續檢查時機。當代理收到長時間背景指令的提示時，對話紀錄會顯示「Waiting for background task」，讓你明白它為何開始動作；針對仍在執行的背景指令，重複發出的等待請求也不再卡住整個等待時間。即使電腦負載偏高或硬碟緩慢，新啟動的監聽器也會即刻出現在頁尾與 `/tasks` 清單中。在長程目標模式（goal run，讓 AI 自主推進多步驟目標的執行流程）下，若工具執行後產生了新的下一步指引，它會替換既有指引並繼續前進，不再提早停下；僅在指引完全相同時才會如常停止。
body.en: When launching long-running jobs in the terminal, prompt frequencies and status displays in conversation windows are now arranged much more clearly. Background commands running longer than 30 minutes will now proactively prompt the agent only once instead of reminding it every half hour, leaving the agent to schedule follow-up checks when needed. When an agent receives a prompt for a long-running background command, the conversation log displays "Waiting for background task" so you understand why it started taking action. Repeated wait requests for background commands that are still executing no longer stall the entire wait duration. Even under heavy machine load or slow disk speeds, newly started listeners appear immediately in the footer and the `/tasks` list. In goal run mode (an execution flow where AI autonomously advances multi-step goals), if a tool run produces new next-step guidance, it replaces existing guidance and continues moving forward rather than stopping early. It only stops as usual when the guidance is completely identical.

items.original:
A background command that runs past 30 minutes now prompts the agent once instead of every 30 minutes; the agent schedules its own later check if it needs one
The transcript shows "Waiting for background task" when the agent is prompted about a long-running background command, so you can see why it started working
A duplicate wait for a background command that is still running no longer holds the chat for its full requested wait
A monitor you start now appears in the footer and in `/tasks` right away, even when the machine is busy or the disk is slow
A long goal run no longer stops early when fresh next-step guidance replaces still-active guidance after new tool work; identical guidance still stops as before

title.zh-TW: 沙盒環境嚴格隔離設定目錄，Git 技能禁止擅自隱藏未追蹤檔案
title.en: Sandbox Environment Strictly Isolates Config Directories, Forbidding Git Skill from Hiding Untracked Files

body.zh-TW: 把終端機指令交給 AI 時，機密資料與檔案庫的安全界線至關重要。沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行的受限環境）指令，無法再讀取或修改 `~/.config/muse`、`~/.config/tbh` 或 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 下的登入資訊、設定、核准規則與被封鎖程式。任務只要求乾淨工作樹時，Git 技能拒絕用忽略規則或 stash 隱藏未追蹤檔案。掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）參數 `model_provider` 改標註模型供應商；僅 Meta 閘道列為 Meta 擁有的模型回報 `meta`，其餘省略，其上的 Claude 或 GPT 工作階段不再回報為 `meta`。⟦像訪客證開不了保險櫃，清潔工也不准把雜物塞進抽屜掩蓋混亂。⟧
body.en:
When delegating terminal commands to AI, the security boundaries of sensitive credentials and repositories are critical. Sandboxed commands (a restricted environment for isolated execution) can no longer read or modify login credentials, settings, approval rules, or blocked applications under `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh`, or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`. When a task only requires a clean worktree, the Git skill refuses to hide untracked files using ignore rules or stash. The hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) parameter `model_provider` now indicates the model provider. Only models listed as Meta-owned by the Meta gateway report `meta`, while others omit it, so Claude or GPT sessions running on it no longer report `meta`.

⟦Just as a visitor badge cannot open a safe, a cleaner is also forbidden to shove clutter into drawers to hide a mess.⟧

items.original:
Security: Sandboxed commands can no longer read or change sign-in details, settings, approval rules or blocked apps stored in `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh` or the same folders under `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`
Security: The git skill now refuses to hide your untracked files with ignore rules or a stash when a task only asks for a clean tree
Security: Hook input `model_provider` now names the vendor of the selected model instead of the connection it was routed through: it is `meta` only for a model the built-in Meta gateway catalog lists as Meta-owned, and is omitted otherwise, so a Claude or GPT session on the Meta gateway no longer reports `meta`

title.zh-TW: 工作流程子任務獨立重試，崩潰重啟精準標記中斷狀態
title.en: Workflow Subtasks Retry Independently, Accurately Tagging Interrupted States upon Crash Restarts

body.zh-TW: 執行包含多個子任務的工作流程時，單一環節發生中斷不再導致整個流程無故卡死。如果工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動化執行的機制）的子任務因啟動紀錄無法儲存，或該任務已存有另一筆不同的啟動紀錄而停止，現在會以白話說明未執行任何新操作、其餘子任務仍持續運作，並指引下一步做法。排定重試後立刻遭中斷的任務，恢復時會依照原記錄的模型與思考力度接續運作。若恢復的任務初次儲存在任何內容寫入前就失敗，僅有該任務會重試而非中斷整個流程；重試的儲存再失敗，也僅標記該任務失敗，並告訴你下一步該怎麼做。遇崩潰重新啟動時，若已終止的代理重啟遭拒，其紀錄列會直接標為失敗並讓整體流程完工，不再誤顯為執行中。
body.en: When executing workflows containing multiple subtasks, an interruption in a single step no longer stalls the entire flow without explanation. If a subtask in a workflow (a mechanism that chains multiple subtasks for automated execution) stops because its launch record cannot be saved, or because a different launch record already exists for it, it now explains in plain language that no new operations were run, confirms that other subtasks are still running, and guides next steps. Tasks interrupted immediately after scheduling a retry will resume operation using the originally recorded model and reasoning effort. If an initial save of a resumed task fails before any content is written, only that task retries instead of interrupting the entire workflow. If the retried save fails again, it only marks that task as failed and tells you what to do next. Upon restarting after a crash, if a terminated agent is rejected for restart, its record row is directly marked as failed and allows the overall workflow to finish, rather than mistakenly displaying as running.

items.original:
A Workflow child that stops because its start record can't be saved, or because a different start record was already saved for it, now says in plain words that nothing new ran, that the other Workflow children keep running, and what to do next
A Workflow task that was interrupted right after it scheduled a retry now resumes with its recorded model and effort instead of being held
When a resumed Workflow task's first save fails before anything is written, only that task retries instead of the whole Workflow stopping; if the retry's save fails too, only that task fails and tells you what to do next
A Workflow resumed after a crash no longer shows a killed agent as still running when its relaunch is refused before it starts; the killed attempt's row now ends Failed and the Workflow completes

title.zh-TW: 工作流程恢復後保留自訂名稱，控制台與即時進度完整顯示
title.en: Workflows Retain Custom Names After Resuming, Displaying Fully in Console and Live Progress

body.zh-TW: 為工作流程取了清楚好記的專屬名稱，卻常在重新啟動或查閱紀錄時被打回預設代號。現在工作流程中途暫停並重新恢復後，各項流程訊息與結束提示都會完整保留先前記錄的自訂名稱。控制室面板以及點開的執行結果頁面，也會持續顯示該流程原本的名稱。新儲存的流程歷史紀錄與即時動態更新都會採用所記錄的名稱；如果遇上過去未儲存名稱的舊版執行紀錄，介面則會明確標記為「name unavailable」，方便你清楚辨識。⟦跟在專案檔案夾貼上手寫標籤一樣，中途交接給其他班次時，標籤依然牢牢貼在封面，不再因為換人接手就退回空白編號。⟧
body.en:
Giving a workflow a clear and memorable custom name often used to result in it reverting to a default identifier upon restarting or checking records. Now, after a workflow is paused mid-run and resumed, workflow messages and finish prompts fully retain the previously recorded custom name. The Mission Control panel and opened run result pages also consistently display the workflow's original name. Newly saved workflow history records and real-time live updates will use the recorded name. If encountering legacy execution records where names were not previously saved, the interface clearly marks them as "name unavailable" for easy identification.

⟦Much like a handwritten label taped to a project folder stays firmly on the cover during a handover to another shift, it no longer reverts to a blank number just because someone else took over.⟧

items.original:
Workflow messages and exit prompts keep the recorded name after resume
Workflow control rooms and opened results keep the recorded workflow name
Newly saved workflow history and live updates use recorded names, with "name unavailable" for older runs that have none

title.zh-TW: 子代理忠實遵從自訂思考力度，支援父任務等待時並行處理
title.en: Subagents Faithfully Honor Custom Reasoning Effort, Supporting Concurrent Processing While Parent Waits

body.zh-TW: 調派多個子代理分頭協同作業時，每位代理的推理深度與模型指派現在都能精準維持。透過工作階段協定啟動的工作階段，現在會遵循所儲存的思考力度（reasoning effort，決定模型在回答前投入多少深度推理的參數）。子代理會嚴格遵循其代理定義中設定的思考力度與專屬模型；當定義的模型無法使用時，會發出通知並改為備援使用當前工作階段的模型。若工作流程中的子代理指名了你工作階段的模型，即使該模型在重啟後被隱藏或自模型清單中移除，子代理依然會維持運行。在父代理處於等待狀態時，子代理現在獲准同步處理待處理的結果，不再平白枯等。⟦彷彿專案主管在等待外部回覆時，被分派任務的助理無須跟著停工，能繼續整理其他已送達的數據資料。⟧
body.en:
When dispatching multiple subagents to collaborate on tasks, the reasoning depth and model assignment of each agent can now be maintained precisely. Sessions launched via the session protocol now follow the saved reasoning effort (a parameter determining how much deep reasoning the model invests before answering). Subagents strictly adhere to the reasoning effort and dedicated model specified in their agent definitions. When a defined model is unavailable, a notification is sent, and it falls back to using the current session's model instead. If a subagent in a workflow specifies your session's model, it keeps running even if that model is hidden or removed from the model catalog after a restart. While the parent agent is in a waiting state, subagents are now permitted to process pending results concurrently instead of waiting idly.

⟦Imagine a project manager waiting for an external reply, where assigned assistants need not sit idle and can keep organizing other data that has already arrived.⟧

items.original:
Sessions started through the session protocol honor saved reasoning effort
Subagents now honor the reasoning effort set in their agent definition
A Workflow subagent that named your session's model keeps running after a restart even when that model is now hidden or missing from the model list, the same as one that left the model out
Subagents use their definition's model, falling back to the session model with a notice when unavailable
Allow subagents to process pending results while the parent waits

title.zh-TW: muse serve 載入對話不再卡死其他請求，健全歷史還原與帳號指引
title.en: muse serve No Longer Blocks Other Requests While Loading Chats, Solidifying History Restoration and Account Guidance

body.zh-TW: 將 Muse 當作本機背景伺服器運行時，多個工作階段並行存取的排程機制有了顯著改善。當你透過 `muse serve` 處理龐大對話時，伺服器在首次載入歷史紀錄、恢復或分支工作階段、開啟側邊對話、列出待審批項目或讀取工具輸出時，都能持續回應其他請求，不再拖住其他對話；嘗試恢復載入中的工作階段也會依序等待，而非誤報已被佔用。它現在能直接顯示 Muse 1.4.8 仍運行中的對話紀錄，即便儲存檢視檔案遭刪除也能正常還原。若啟動時缺乏模型清單且帳號需補填付款方式、新手導覽或年齡確認，對話輪次會明確說明該做什麼，不再無端要求重新登入。
body.en: When running Muse as a local background server, the scheduling mechanism for concurrent session access has improved significantly. When handling large conversations via `muse serve`, the server continues responding to other requests while initially loading history, resuming or branching sessions, opening side chats, listing pending approval items, or reading tool outputs, without stalling other conversations. Attempts to resume a session that is currently loading will now wait in turn rather than falsely reporting that it is already occupied. It can now directly display ongoing conversation records from Muse 1.4.8 and cleanly restore them even if saved view files were deleted. If the model list is missing at startup and the account requires adding a payment method, completing onboarding, or confirming age, the turn explicitly explains what needs to be done instead of prompting for a re-login without explanation.

items.original:
`muse serve` now shows the history of a session that Muse 1.4.8 is still running, instead of failing to read it until that session closes
When a `muse serve` client resumes a chat whose saved history view file was deleted, the chat shows its history again instead of none
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while a long session's history loads for the first time, and resuming a session that is still loading waits for it instead of reporting the session as in use
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while it resumes or forks a long session, opens a side chat on one, lists its pending approvals or reads one of its tool outputs, instead of stalling every other thread until that session's history is read
When `muse serve` starts with no saved model list and your account still needs a payment method, onboarding or age confirmation, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again

title.zh-TW: 手動壓縮支援外接工具，修正檢查點儲存並加速大型工作階段分支
title.en: Manual Compaction Supports External Tools, Fixing Checkpoint Saves and Accelerating Large Session Branching

body.zh-TW: 對話內容過長而需要精簡上下文時，手動輸入 `/compact` 的觸發條件與儲存機制現在更為可靠。設定了外接工具 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的工作階段，現在可以直接執行手動 `/compact`，不再回報無可壓縮內容。在儲存檢查點時若恰好遇到其他寫入操作，不會再遺漏儲存；重新開啟已儲存的對話後，壓縮也能持續正常運作，不再重複摘要並最終報錯。如果在送出模型請求前就取消訊息，執行壓縮會如實回報沒有內容可摘要，避免留下錯誤檢查點而導致後續跳過開發者指令。當工具結果被清除或提醒過期時，`/compact` 的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計算已獲修正；在經歷壓縮的超大型工作階段中，執行 `/btw`、`/side` 與 `/fork` 的開啟速度也明顯加快。
body.en: When conversations grow too long and context needs trimming, the trigger conditions and saving mechanisms for manually running `/compact` are now much more reliable. Sessions configured with external MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol enabling AI to connect to external tools) tools can now directly run manual `/compact` without reporting that there is nothing to compact. Saving a checkpoint while another write operation is occurring no longer drops the save. After reopening a saved conversation, compaction continues working normally rather than repeatedly summarizing and ultimately erroring out. If a message is canceled before sending the model request, running compaction accurately reports that there is no content to summarize, preventing invalid checkpoints that could cause subsequent developer instructions to be skipped. The token (a text unit for AI processing and billing) calculation for `/compact` has been corrected when tool results are cleared or reminders expire. In very large compacted sessions, opening speeds for running `/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` are also noticeably faster.

items.original:
Manual `/compact` now compacts sessions with MCP servers configured, instead of answering "no compactable run is available"
A context compaction no longer skips its checkpoint when another session write lands while that checkpoint is being saved
Running /compact in a chat whose turns all ended before any model request (for example, a message cancelled before Muse began preparing its model request) now reports that there is nothing to summarize instead of writing a summary checkpoint that could later let the chat skip setting up its developer instructions
Compaction keeps working after you reopen a saved chat, instead of summarizing again at every boundary and eventually failing with "could not prepare the conversation"
Correct `/compact` token counts when tool results are cleared or reminders expire
`/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` open faster in very large compacted sessions

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復嚴格檢驗啟動紀錄，掛鉤只在紀錄完整時觸發執行
title.en: Session Resumption Strictly Verifies Startup Logs, Firing Hooks Only When Logs Are Fully Intact

body.zh-TW: 重新開啟先前儲存的對話時，若背後的執行紀錄曾發生缺損，盲目載入往往會引發非預期的錯誤。如果工作階段的日誌無法證實其最後一次啟動紀錄，現在會直接拒絕恢復該對話，並在訊息中點名損毀的紀錄，不再默默開啟。在終端機介面恢復工作階段時，只有日誌能證實啟動完整的對話才會觸發 SessionStart 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），其來源會標註為 `resume`。若對象是從未啟動的分支副本，來源則標註為 `fork`。若是無法證實啟動的副本，則完全不執行掛鉤並在啟動通知中說明。已儲存的工作階段格式也新增了標記欄位，可記錄儲存當下是否仍在啟動中；雖然目前尚未正式寫入，但未來一旦開始記錄，舊版 Muse 將拒絕開啟這類工作階段以防出錯。
body.en: When reopening a previously saved conversation, blindly loading it often causes unexpected errors if the underlying execution logs were corrupted. If a session log cannot verify its last startup record, it now explicitly refuses to resume that conversation and names the corrupted record in the message, rather than opening silently. When resuming a session in the terminal interface, only conversations whose startup can be verified by the log will trigger the SessionStart hook (a small program triggered by a specific event), with its source marked as `resume`. For branched copies that have never been started, the source is marked as `fork`. For copies whose startup cannot be verified, the hook is not executed at all, and an explanation is provided in the startup notification. The saved session format also adds a flag field to record whether it was still starting up at the time of saving. Although not actively written yet, once recorded in the future, legacy versions of Muse will refuse to open such sessions to prevent errors.

items.original:
Saved sessions can record whether a run was still starting when they were saved; nothing records it yet, so no session opens differently today, and once a later Muse records it, Muse versions released before that one will not open such a session
Resuming a session whose log cannot prove its last start is refused with a message naming the broken record instead of opening silently
SessionStart hooks run on every resumed TUI session whose log proves its last start, reporting `resume` (or `fork` for a never-activated clone) as their source; a replayed copy that cannot prove it runs none and says so in its startup notice

title.zh-TW: 跨桌面與終端切換即時同步對話，分支重試具備冪等性不再撞號
title.en: Real-time conversation sync across desktop and terminal switches, with idempotent branch retries that prevent collisions

body.zh-TW: 在桌面應用程式與終端機之間切換工作環境時，不同版本之間的對話紀錄接軌現在省去了不必要的等待。若桌面端與終端機運行的 Muse Code 版本不同，切換時會直接同步另一端剛進行的簡短對話，不再從頭重新建構歷史紀錄（自 1.4.9 以前版本升級後的首次開啟仍會重建一次）。恢復進度落後的對話時，會在同一次恢復中直接補齊最新紀錄，不再出現歷史空白或遺漏即時回覆。使用相同指令識別碼重試分支時，會符合冪等（idempotent，多次執行結果與單次相同）原則直接回傳原始結果，不再報錯；指定不同切分時則維持衝突。即使對話含有中途送達的背景任務通知，分支在應用程式與 SDK 也能順利載入。工作階段中模型重複使用工具識別碼不再破壞後續壓縮，載入重複核准紀錄的工作階段時記憶體消耗也明顯降低。
body.en: When switching work environments between the desktop application and the terminal, bridging conversation history across different versions now eliminates unnecessary waiting. If the desktop app and terminal run different versions of Muse Code, switching will directly sync recent short conversations from the other side rather than rebuilding history from scratch (the first launch after upgrading from versions prior to 1.4.9 still rebuilds once). When restoring a conversation that has fallen behind, the latest records are backfilled in the same restoration pass, preventing history gaps or missing real-time replies. When retrying a branch using the same command identifier, it adheres to idempotent principles (yielding identical results when run multiple times as when run once) and directly returns the original result instead of throwing an error. Specifying a different split continues to raise a conflict. Even if a conversation contains background task notifications delivered midway, branches load smoothly across both the application and the SDK. A model reusing tool identifiers within a session no longer breaks subsequent compaction, and memory consumption drops significantly when loading sessions with duplicate approval records.

items.original:
A forked chat whose history has a background-task notice delivered mid-turn now opens in apps and SDKs in more cases, instead of failing to load
Switching a conversation between the desktop app and the terminal when they run different versions of Muse Code now catches up a short exchange made on the other side instead of rebuilding its saved history from scratch; the first open after updating from a release before 1.4.9 still rebuilds it once
Resuming a thread whose saved history had fallen far behind now brings it up to date in that same resume, instead of showing no history and missing live replies until the next resume
A session whose model reused a tool call id for two same-length results no longer becomes impossible to resume or compact after old tool results are cleared
Retrying a fork with the same command id now returns the original outcome instead of answering command_id_conflict, matching gate-off idempotency; reusing a command id with a different cut still conflicts
Reduce memory use when loading sessions with repeated approval records

title.zh-TW: 長篇分析回答改用短句分段，隱藏無回應標記並自動補問
title.en: Long analytical responses switch to short-sentence paragraphs, hiding no-reply markers with automatic follow-up questions

body.zh-TW: 閱讀 AI 產生的長篇分析報告時，密密麻麻的一整片文字往往讓人難以快速抓住重點。現在遇到長篇分析類型的回答，模型會主動採用短句與精簡段落進行排版，取代過去整面難以閱讀的文字牆。若先前對話中途意外中斷，使得某一輪的最終結果只剩下一行「前一輪未產生助手回覆」的內部標記，Muse 會自動發起一次有限度的重新提問，為你取得真正的實質回覆，並在執行摘要中主動剔除該標記。對話紀錄面板也不再顯示帶有菱形符號的「◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]」提示列；如果回答只包含該標記，畫面不會渲染任何內容，若標記後方附有正常回答，則只乾淨呈現正式的回答內容。⟦恰似專業編輯重新編排文稿，不僅將密集論述切成清晰段落，也在印製時主動抽除排版留下的空白除錯標記。⟧
body.en: When reading long analytical reports generated by AI, dense walls of text often make it hard to quickly grasp key points. When encountering long analytical responses, the model now proactively formats output using short sentences and concise paragraphs, replacing the previously unreadable walls of text. If a previous conversation was interrupted unexpectedly so that a turn's final output was left with only an internal marker indicating that the prior turn produced no assistant reply, Muse automatically issues a bounded re-prompt to retrieve a genuine response, actively stripping that marker from the run summaries. The conversation history panel also no longer displays the prompt bar `◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]` with its diamond symbol. If a response contains only that marker, the screen renders nothing, and if normal answers follow the marker, it cleanly presents only the formal response content. ⟦A professional editor reformats a manuscript by breaking dense arguments into clear paragraphs and stripping out leftover blank debugging marks before printing.⟧

items.original:
Long analysis answers use short sentences and paragraphs instead of dense walls of text
A turn whose final answer consists only of the "[Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" marker now gets one bounded re-prompt for a real reply, and the marker is stripped from run summaries
The transcript no longer shows a "◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" row — a reply containing only that resume marker renders nothing, and a real answer prefixed by it shows just the answer

title.zh-TW: 開發者指令阻擋改以白話引導，SDK 撤回狀態與技能範例修復
title.en: Developer command blocks switch to plain-language guidance, and SDK retraction states and skill examples receive fixes

body.zh-TW: 串接工具時，晦澀報錯常令人卡關。EdenFS 查全庫 Sapling（`hg files`、`hg locate`、`hg manifest`）卡死前阻擋，改指引 `search` 或 `hg biggrep`。衍生子行程遭拒改以白話說明，不再顯示內部列舉代碼。連接外部工具的 MCP 伺服器啟動存活未回，改報 `the server did not respond during startup` 而非泛用逾時。TypeScript 與 Python SDK 撤回遭拒不再誤標撤回或丟棄；前者的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 納入 `turn/retracted`，窮舉比對需補分支。內建 Three.js 技能改用可運作的 WebGPU 後製，不再引用已移除舊檔。
body.en: When integrating tools, cryptic error messages often cause roadblocks. Sapling repository-wide queries on EdenFS (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) are blocked before hanging, redirecting users to `search` or `hg biggrep`. Spawned subprocess rejections are now explained in plain language instead of displaying internal enum codes. When an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server fails to respond during startup liveness checks, it now reports `the server did not respond during startup` instead of a generic timeout. Retraction rejections in the TypeScript and Python SDKs are no longer mistakenly marked as retracted or dropped. The former's `StaleDroppableMethod` now incorporates `turn/retracted`, requiring an additional branch for exhaustive matching. The built-in Three.js skill now switches to working WebGPU post-processing instead of referencing removed legacy files.

items.original:
Spawn rejection hints now explain the reason in plain words instead of internal enum names
Repository-wide Sapling file listings (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) on EdenFS checkouts are refused before they hang, pointing at `search` or `hg biggrep` instead
An MCP server whose process stays alive but never responds during startup now fails with `the server did not respond during startup` instead of the generic operation timeout
The TypeScript and Python SDKs no longer mark a turn retracted, or drop its completion, when its retract is declined; in the TypeScript SDK, `StaleDroppableMethod` gains `turn/retracted`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case
The bundled Three.js skill now gives a working WebGPU post-processing example instead of one that imports a file current three.js no longer ships
